title: Your asks, tallied: how often each feature was requested and whether it got done

chat.text: Haiku minions read every owner prompt since mid-September in small chunks and pull out each ask with a feature tag; a script clusters and counts them; Haiku then finds each feature's landing line or says it has none. An Opus mastermind spot-checks ten verdicts. The page leads with the most-asked features that are not done, then the contradictions, then the full tally. Extends the 10-08 prompt audit rather than redoing it.

message.text: task-mastermind-prompt-outcomes: The second Haiku run has finished 11 of 20 chunks with no errors, at $2.32 so far. When it's done I'll tally the asks by feature, then get the verdicts.
